html:
If you’ve ever opened your car door on a hot Australian afternoon and been hit with a wall of heat, you know just how uncomfortable it can be. Cranking the air conditioner feels like the only solution, but that burns more fuel and puts extra strain on your vehicle.

Car solar film is a practical upgrade that changes how your car handles heat, glare and sun exposure. But this isn’t just about staying cool. It’s about protecting your vehicle, enhancing comfort, and making every drive more efficient.

With over 50 years of experience, Tint a Car has been helping Australians enjoy safer, smarter driving with professionally installed, ARPANSA-certified films that block UV, cut down cabin temperatures and help your car perform better on the road. Learn how solar film for cars works, why it matters, and which option is best for your needs.

Stay cooler with less effort every time you drive

High-quality solar film reduces the amount of heat that builds up inside your vehicle by filtering infrared and solar radiation before it enters.

For instance, Black Panther blocks up to 99% of infrared heat, while Octane rejects 62% of total solar energy. The results are a noticeably cooler interior, even after your car’s been parked in the sun.

Whether you’re driving a compact hatchback or an SUV, less solar heat means less discomfort, no more burning seats or sweaty steering wheels. It’s one of the simplest ways to make your daily drive more enjoyable.

Block the sun, protect your car’s interior

UV rays don’t just affect people, they’re one of the leading causes of vehicle interior damage. Left unprotected, sunlight can cause dashboards to crack, leather to fade, and trims to warp.

Tint a Car’s films block 99% of UV radiation and are certified UPF 50+ by ARPANSA, offering the same level of protection as high-quality sunscreen. That means your car’s interior stays in top condition longer, and your passengers are shielded from harmful UV exposure.

This kind of protection doesn’t just add comfort, it helps maintain your vehicle’s resale value.

Common Questions and Answers

How long does it last? With proper installation, our tints last for years with no bubbling, peeling, or fading.
